app.name: Challenge Tree
app.tagline: Build understanding. Open the next branch.
home.workspaceSaveHint: All learning trees and answer history can be saved in one workspace file.
home.connectHint: Start the local connector to research, generate challenges, and grade answers.
home.setupDescription: Download and start the connector for your operating system. This page will connect automatically—no Node.js installation or URL entry is required.
home.setupStartHint: Keep it running while you use Challenge Tree. macOS/Linux may ask you to allow the downloaded executable on first launch.
home.setupReturnHint: When the connection diagnostic says Connected, research, challenges, and grading are ready.
home.deleteConfirm: Delete this local tree? Export the workspace first if you want a backup.
create.title: Choose the territory.
create.description: Start with one concept and a clear outcome. Codex will propose three ways into the subject.
create.topic: What do you want to learn?
create.goal: What do you want to understand or be able to explain?
create.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Explain the main design choices well enough to read papers.
create.advancedHint: Optional context for the first proposal
manual.title: Build a learning tree
manual.description: Enter the learning policy and let AI create the first node and challenge.
manual.listHint: Separate items with commas or new lines
proposal.title: Three ways into {topic}.
proposal.description: Each route reveals a different dependency map. Choose the one that fits how you want to think.
proposal.error: The connector could not return three valid proposals.
tree.selectHint: Select a node to inspect its challenge.
tree.manualNodeHint: Add a learning node at the position you right-clicked.
tree.expandHint: After an answer, generate the next learning nodes.
node.noChallenge: No challenge has been prepared for this node yet.
node.answerHint: Write what you understand. Structure matters less than showing the causal idea.
node.answerPlaceholder: Explain it in your own words…
node.offline: Answer drafts are saved locally. Grading needs the Codex Connector.
node.notAvailable: This node is not available yet.
grade.title: Challenge review
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: This changes the interface only. Research mode stays with each tree.
settings.connectorReadyHint: Start the portable connector and this browser will detect the local connection automatically.
settings.modelHint: Choose the Codex model used for research, challenges, and grading.
settings.modelLoadError: Could not load the model list.
settings.modelSaveError: The selected model could not be applied.
settings.reasoningEffortHint: Choose a reasoning level supported by the selected model.
import.invalid: This file is not a compatible Challenge Tree save.
import.success: Imported {count} learning tree(s) into the workspace.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your local draft is safe; try again.
error.invalidOutput: Codex returned data that did not match the required format. Retry to repair it.
footer.local: Local-first · Your progress stays in this browser
